verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents retry behavior or automatic recovery from popups, state drift, or failed actions. The human step-in and takeover features (cua-docs-18, cua-docs-11) are a different, manual control and earn no credit here. A community user reported the agent typing in the wrong place and runs failing to connect, and another user asked openly how intermittent popups are handled; neither shows any documented recovery mechanism.
